title: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value is not a recognised token
description: The X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies value is none of the five defined tokens (`none`, `master-only`, `by-content-type`, `by-ftp-filename`, `all`). A client that does not recognise the token falls back to its default, so the header states a policy that is not the policy in force.
remediation: Use one of the five defined tokens, normally `none`. Remove values invented by a framework or copied from an unrelated deployment.
limitation: One header value. The rule validates the token and does not inspect whether a cross-domain policy file is actually served.
